summary: Iteration 508 RMS features (Profit-First Pricing, Group Displacement v2, ABS, RevPAM) tested end-to-end. Backend: 9 of 10 pytest cases passed, 1 skipped due to prior test-run booking collision (RevPAM override rate booking verified once at 130). Frontend: all 4 admin panels render, cpor save persists, ABS attribute add works (9→10 rows), RevPAM apply button clickable, GD analyzer shows gd-net-row + shoulder/comm/netafter KPIs. Widget booking with ABS now works after two bug fixes.

critical.issue: Crashed with TypeError NoneType*int when a room_types record has base_rate=null (default property Standard Double). This blocked ALL public bookings on property 'default'. FIXED by changing 'room.get(base_rate, 100)' to 'room.get(base_rate) or 100' at booking_widget.py L150.

ui_bugs.issue: abs_attribute_ids not sent in POST /booking-widget/book payload — UI showed correct £230 total but backend stored abs_total=0 and total=200. FIXED by adding abs_attribute_ids: absSelected at L332 of BookingWidgetPage.js. Verified booking WEB-1E1278AC now stores total=230, abs_total=30.
Missing data-testid='abs-line-<id>' on ABS lines inside the Booking Summary column (spec called for them). Total updates correctly but individual line testids not present.
gd-rooms-input and gd-rate-input testids missing on the form inputs (analyze still works with defaults, but tests cannot programmatically set 60 rooms/70 rate via those testids).

integration_issues.issue: See BookingWidgetPage ABS bug above — root cause was missing abs_attribute_ids field in the /book payload.

action_items: Verify the two fixes applied (booking_widget.py L150 base_rate null-guard, BookingWidgetPage.js L332 abs_attribute_ids in payload) are acceptable.
Add data-testid abs-line-<id> to ABS entries in Booking Summary column in BookingWidgetPage.js.
Add data-testid gd-rooms-input and gd-rate-input to GroupDisplacementPanel form inputs.
Consider seeding non-null base_rate for room_types on property 'default' to remove reliance on fallback (100).
critical_code_review_comments: booking_widget.py used room.get('base_rate', 100) which does not guard against explicit null → caused 500 for the entire public booking flow. Prefer 'or 100' pattern for optional numeric fields anywhere DB may store null.

BookingWidgetPage.js iteration 508 wired absSelected in the UI total calculation but forgot to include it in the POST payload — indicative of missing an E2E integration test. Adding a small Playwright regression covering ABS+booking would catch this.
profit_pricing/abs/revpam/group_displacement route files load correctly; ObjectId is not serialized (all endpoints tested returned JSON without _id issues).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all admin panels + widget ABS flow work after fixes; minor missing testids)

seed_data_creation: Added TEST_UI_Attr_508 (£17) via ABS panel; TEST_Balkon manzarası via backend upsert test (multiple duplicates due to running upsert repeatedly — recommend cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two bugs fixed in this iteration — please keep the fixes: (1) booking_widget.py L150 uses 'or 100' fallback; (2) BookingWidgetPage.js POST payload includes abs_attribute_ids. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration508_rms_features.py can be reused as regression. The RevPAM apply/booking test skips if same date already booked earlier in the day — consider randomizing target_date.
rca of the issue: 1) Public booking widget 500: seeded room_types record had base_rate=null; .get(key, default) returns null (not default) if the key exists with a None value, then None*int throws TypeError. 2) ABS not saved on widget booking: frontend UI computed +£30 for Deniz manzarası but the POST body to /booking-widget/book did not include abs_attribute_ids, so the backend re-computed total from rate*nights and stored abs_total=0. Fix was adding abs_attribute_ids: absSelected to the payload.
